thread:
Ethan (Finance): Vendor Ops invoiced ClientX for Private deployment and charged a one-time "platform setup" of $120k. Our contract S-5001 shows a $10k monthly platform fee, not a one-time. Did we approve a prepay?
Priya (RevOps): I pulled S-5001 in CLM. It explicitly lists monthly recurring platform fee $10,000 and Standard support $1,200/mo. No prepay language.
Liam (CS): Customer did ask about an annual discount in convo with acct exec, but I don't see an approved amendment. @Priya any signed amendment?
Priya (RevOps): No amendment in CLM, no signature. There is an unsigned quote (Q-889) that mentions annual prepay with 10% discount, but not executed.
VendorOps (Vendor): FYI we received invoice request from client procurement with PO PO-99001 requesting vendor to bill annual. We created invoice INV-2025-AC77 per PO. We can void if notified.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-AC77 created by vendor-ingest (job id vi-2025-03-18).
Ethan (Finance): PO mismatch then. Client PO requested annual but contract doesn't authorize it. Need to avoid recognizing revenue incorrectly.
Julie (Billing): Agreed. Two paths: 1) Void vendor invoice, ask vendor to reissue monthly invoices; 2) Accept invoice then issue credit memos and re-bill monthly, but that complicates rev recognition. Which do we prefer?
Priya (RevOps): Prefer void and reissue monthly to keep revenue timing straightforward. Also need a rev hold note until corrected.
Liam (CS): I'll ping the customer procurement and ask them to withdraw the PO or provide an executed amendment. Quick note to customer: we can't invoice annually without signed amendment.
VendorOps (Vendor): We'll hold on cash application. Please confirm in writing and we'll void INV-2025-AC77 and reissue per monthly schedule once we receive updated PO/ammendment.
Ethan (Finance): Julie, can you open a billing ticket and tag Rev/Revenue close loop? Also include impact on deferred revenue schedule if we had recognized the one-time.
Julie (Billing): Opening ticket BILL-672 now. Target: void vendor invoice by EOD and request reissue monthly. Will attach vendor confirmation and set a rev hold flag.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-672 (priority P1) linked to INV-2025-AC77 and contract S-5001.
Priya (RevOps): Approving the void path. Once vendor confirms void, I'll add a rev note and block recognition in the month close.
Ethan (Finance): Approved. Please also note customer PO and procurement contact for audit trail. Liam, drop the procurement contact into the ticket.
Liam (CS): Done. Added procurement contact and copied procurement thread. I'll message procurement now.
VendorOps (Vendor): Confirmed: we'll void INV-2025-AC77 and await reissue instructions.
Ethan (Finance): Thanks all. Follow-up: Julie to post credit memo or void confirmation in BILL-672, Priya to update rev hold, Liam to confirm PO withdrawal.
Julie (Billing): Will post updates in BILL-672 and close when reissue is complete.
